has_own_site_note: CRITICAL CORRECTION vs. the discovery brief: the business DOES have its own website (palmettopestsolutions.com, WordPress, uploaded Nov 2026). The brief's 'has_own_site: false / verified' was wrong. Confirmed directly: HTTP 200, title 'Trusted Pest Control in Port St. Lucie, FL - Palmetto Pest Solutions', own address/phone/email/hours/services/testimonials, own green palm-tree logo. Outreach angle must be an alternative/redesign concept, never 'you don't have a website'.
instagram_note: Confirmed via Thumbtack's social redirect links (facebook/instagram). IG feed is mostly promo graphics with text overlays (sale flyers, holiday posts, screenshots of their own site) + a few real field photos; used research_ig.py to pull 12 posts, only 1 (hero-treatment.jpg) was a clean usable work photo without text overlay.
google_maps_note: Place ID and coordinates confirmed by resolving the two maps.app.goo.gl short links published on the business's own site. Google's star rating/review count could not be read mechanically (the Maps page is JS-rendered and returned no plain-text rating in the raw HTML fetch). Used Thumbtack's live, directly-fetched rating (4.7, 41 reviews, 93% five-star) as the primary published number instead, since it was fully verifiable. Other small directories show conflicting/tiny samples: Yelp 3.0 (2 reviews), Yahoo Local 2.5 (3 reviews) -- not used, sample too small and inconsistent with the Thumbtack and the business's own-site testimonials.
services: Termite inspection and treatment (drywood and subterranean), bait station installation and monitoring
General household pest control (recurring interior + exterior, German cockroach, rodent baiting, fire ants included)
Ant treatment (fire ants and common household ants)
services_source: Own website (palmettopestsolutions.com) service menu. No prices published anywhere (Thumbtack shows 'Contact for price'); site itself says 'transparent pricing, no hidden charges, clear estimate before work begins' and 'free inspection'. No prices were invented; demo uses that same free-inspection framing instead of dollar figures.

reviewSamples.author: Maddie M.
reviewSamples.text: I contacted several pest control companies and chose Palmetto Pest Solutions because they were responsive, knowledgeable, and offered fair pricing without requiring a contract. Chris and his team arrived on time, explained everything in detail, and treated our home like it was their own. You can tell they genuinely care about their customers and take pride in their work.

reviewSamples.author: Andy T.
reviewSamples.text: I've been working with them for just over a year now and they are so much better than Orkin. They are super responsive, best in class pest control and customer service. I could not be happier with Palmetto Pest Solutions, these guys are the fantastic!

reviewSamples.author: Elani H.
reviewSamples.text: Palmetto Pest Solutions exceeded my expectations! This was my first time using them, and the entire experience was amazing from beginning to end. They were incredibly kind, professional, and made me feel completely comfortable throughout the process.

reviewSamples.author: LaShea G.
reviewSamples.text: Palmetto pest control was amazing and very accommodating. We had some work being done on our house on the day that they were scheduled to come and had to reschedule with them last minute, and they kindly came the next day.

reviewSamples.author: David Simmons
reviewSamples.text: We love Palmetto, they provide complete pest control solutions at a fair price. Since we have been using them we have not had any problems and they are very responsive to our pest control needs. I highly recommend Chris and his family.

reviewSamples_note: Task brief quoted 4.9/38 reviews/97% five-star from Thumbtack and two review snippets ('Fantastic service!' and the Maddie M. quote). Re-fetched Thumbtack live today (2026-11-14): current numbers are 4.7 / 41 reviews / 93% five-star -- used the fresher, directly-verified figures. The exact phrase 'Fantastic service!' was not found verbatim on the live page; the Maddie M. 'fair pricing without requiring a contract' quote WAS confirmed verbatim and is used in the demo.
photos_used: assets/raw/gallery-sprayer-yard.jpg (Yelp business photo, real, wide gallery tile)
assets/raw/owner-chris.jpg (cropped from an Instagram ad graphic, owner Chris McDougald, used ONLY as a small avatar per gate rule, never as a gallery tile)
assets/raw/logo-mark.png (business's own green palm-tree logo, used in nav/footer)
photos_discarded: 9 of 17 Yelp CDN photos pulled via MapQuest's photo feed were clearly unrelated to this business (a dinner plate, a dog, a mini-golf sign, a kitchen interior, a park) or showed a different-looking crew (blue coveralls/respirator doing attic insulation) -- discarded as unverifiable/likely mismatched rather than risk presenting someone else's work as Palmetto's.
11 of 12 Instagram posts were promo graphics (sale flyers, holiday posts, screenshots of their own website) with text overlays -- disqualified by the gate's 'no captions/text over the photo' rule.

Two images from the business's own website were stock photography (one with Bigstock EXIF copyright, one a generic sunset-house stock photo) and one was an AI-generated-looking 'McDougald Family' composite with a text overlay -- all three discarded, not used as real documentation of the business.
